ssh_throttled_informational.note: Windows power-throttling of background processes, not the reranker: same machine, same batches, foreground 10x faster; CPU 87% idle during the slow phase. Not the gating measurement.

unconstrained.method: Session-1 foreground probe (p73_a6_probe.py): service adapter, 3 rounds x 12 doc questions, 25 real chunks each, n=36 batches

sub_batch_reverification.note: the int8 model's dynamic activation quantization makes scores batch-composition-dependent (measured max full-vs-sub-batch score diff 0.45 logits; arena on/off exactly 0), so admissibility was re-verified under the shipped 5-pair sub-batched scoring
